component.name: PPPlayer
component.summary: Discover, stream, and play music and videos

description.p: PPPlayer is a modern, beautifully designed media player built with Flutter, bringing music, videos, and online streams together in one seamless experience.

ul.li: Music discovery and online streaming integration
Local media library playback with high-resolution artwork support
Audio output switching (Cast, DLNA, and system output routing)
Network playlist import supporting M3U, PLS, XSPF, and ASX streams
Hardware-accelerated video playback with resizable queue controls

description.p: Release 4.0.1 brings playback engine optimizations, Linux packaging enhancements, and refreshed queue controls.
